observations.why: Directive issued in present tense commands erasure of a category of knowledge — irrealis because the desired state does not yet hold, abstract because it targets a class of information rather than a specific event.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes

observations.why: Present-tense imperative seeking a state change that is not yet actual (irrealis), directed at a specific artifact class — zeppelin routes — making the construal concrete.
